zh.summary: 设置页的权限语言和便携版选择器现在完整对齐 DeepSeek Harness，不再混入英文或浏览器原生下拉样式。
highlights: 内置权限模式统一显示为“只读”“工作区写入”和“完全访问”，英文界面仍显示对应英文名称。
便携版设置改用 DSH 原生菜单与箭头组件，开关和关闭行为的选择器与官方设置保持一致。
权限确认对话框同步使用当前界面语言；第三方插件提供的自定义权限名称保持原样。
启动更新检查、手动检查、组件更新、数据保留和失败回滚均重新通过自动化验收。

en.summary: Permission language and Portable selectors now align with DeepSeek Harness instead of mixing locales or browser-native dropdowns.
highlights: Read only, Workspace write, and Full access now use consistent localized labels across both permission surfaces.
Portable settings now use the native DSH menu and chevron primitives for consistent controls and interaction.
Full-access confirmation dialogs follow the active locale while custom permission names supplied by plugins remain unchanged.
Startup checks, manual checks, component updates, data preservation, and rollback were revalidated.
